title: Browse the landing page and enter the workspace
description: This verifies a visitor can review the landing page value proposition and launch the workspace to reach the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify product value proposition content is displayed
Verify pricing or testimonial content is displayed
Click the primary workspace launch action
Verify the dashboard is displayed

title: Explore landing page and enter the workspace
description: A visitor can review the landing page content and use a primary call to action to reach the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll through the landing page
Scroll through the pricing section
Click the primary call to action to enter the workspace
Verify the dashboard is displayed
Verify executive KPI content is visible

title: Generate an invoice with multiple line items and send it
description: This verifies a user can enter billing details, add line items, calculate totals, and create and send an invoice.

steps.description: Navigate to /invoices
Fill in the client name field
Fill in the invoice item details
Add a line item with quantity and unit price
Add another line item with quantity and unit price
Click to create and send the invoice
Verify the invoice total is displayed
Verify a sent invoice confirmation is visible

title: View dashboard metrics overview
description: An executive can open the dashboard and see the main agency performance summary at a glance.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Verify KPI summary content is visible
Verify overall agency performance metrics are visible

title: Generate a proposal from client requirements
description: A sales user can enter proposal details and generate a proposal preview that reflects the supplied requirements.

steps.description: Navigate to /proposals
Fill in the client name field with a valid client name
Fill in the project scope field with a valid project scope
Fill in the budget field with a valid budget
Fill in the delivery timeline field with a valid timeline
Generate the proposal
Verify a generated proposal preview is displayed
Verify the proposal preview includes the entered requirements

title: Review the dashboard KPI overview
description: This verifies a user can open the dashboard and see executive KPI metrics and summary data needed for agency oversight.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Verify executive KPI metrics are displayed
Verify active performance summary data is displayed

title: Update and save agency settings
description: An operations user can change agency profile and preference settings and save the updated configuration successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /settings
Update agency profile information
Toggle notification preferences
Change team role and integration settings
Save the updated preferences
Verify the updated settings summary is displayed
Verify the saved configuration is reflected on the page

title: Reach the dashboard from pricing content
description: A visitor can review pricing information and still launch into the workspace from the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the pricing section
Click the workspace launch call to action
Verify the dashboard is displayed
Verify executive KPI content is visible

title: Generate a contract and access the signature link
description: This verifies a user can configure contract terms, generate the agreement, and reach the e-signature link from the contract builder.

steps.description: Navigate to /contracts
Select a contract agreement type
Select an IP ownership option
Click to generate the contract
Verify a generated contract summary is displayed
Verify an e-signature link is displayed

title: Review invoice totals before sending
description: This verifies a user can fill billing details, review subtotal, tax, and total calculations, and then create and send the invoice.

steps.description: Navigate to /invoices
Fill in the client name field
Fill in billing details
Add multiple line items with quantity and unit price
Verify the subtotal is displayed
Verify the tax amount and final total are displayed
Click to create and send the invoice
Verify a sent invoice confirmation is visible

title: Inspect dashboard charts and project progress
description: An executive can review dashboard charts and project progress indicators to understand agency performance.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Verify visual chart content is visible
Verify project progress information is visible

title: Review contract terms before sharing
description: This verifies a user can choose agreement terms, generate a contract, and review the resulting summary and signature link.

steps.description: Navigate to /contracts
Choose contract agreement terms
Click to generate the contract
Verify a contract summary is displayed
Verify an e-signature link is displayed

title: Sync sprint status updates
description: An engineering lead can trigger a sprint sync and see the board summary reflect the updated sprint information.

steps.description: Navigate to /jira
Sync sprint status updates
Verify updated sprint information is displayed
Verify the board summary changes

title: View Jira sprint metrics overview
description: An engineering lead can open the Jira dashboard and review sprint metrics, ticket distribution, and epic progress.

steps.description: Navigate to /jira
Verify sprint metrics are displayed
Verify ticket distribution and epic progress information are displayed

title: Search and open a client record
description: This verifies a user can search the client directory, find a matching client, and open the client card for details.

steps.description: Navigate to /clients
Search for a client by name
Verify matching clients are displayed
Open a matching client card
Verify the client card details are displayed

title: Review revenue and active project summary on the dashboard
description: An executive can confirm monthly recurring revenue and active project information are shown together on the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Verify monthly recurring revenue content is visible
Verify active project metrics are visible

title: View project status overview
description: A delivery manager can open the project tracker and see active project status cards with milestone, team, budget, and deadline information.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects
Verify active project status cards are displayed
Verify milestone progress, team assignments, budget consumption, and deadline information are displayed

title: Filter clients by status
description: This verifies a user can filter the directory by client status and see the list update to the matching records.

steps.description: Navigate to /clients
Select a client status filter
Verify the client list is filtered to matching records

title: Inspect Jira issue distribution by epic
description: An engineering lead can review how issues are distributed across epics and confirm the summary remains readable for planning.

steps.description: Navigate to /jira
Open the epic progress view
Verify epic progress information is displayed
Verify issue counts are displayed

title: Filter projects by in-progress status
description: A delivery manager can filter the project list to in-progress work and see the displayed projects update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects
Filter projects to in-progress status
Verify the displayed projects match the selected status group
Verify active project details remain visible

title: Adjust notification and API credential preferences
description: An operations user can modify notification and credential-related preferences and confirm the settings view reflects the new choices.

steps.description: Navigate to /settings
Toggle notification settings
Update API credential preferences
Save the updated preferences
Verify the settings summary updates
Verify notification and credential preferences are displayed

title: Regenerate a proposal after changing requirements
description: A sales user can update proposal inputs and generate a refreshed draft that reflects the new project details.

steps.description: Navigate to /proposals
Fill in the client name field with a valid client name
Fill in the project scope field with an initial project scope
Fill in the budget field with a valid budget
Fill in the delivery timeline field with a valid timeline
Generate the proposal
Update the project scope field with a different valid scope
Generate the proposal again
Verify the proposal preview updates after regeneration
Verify the refreshed preview reflects the updated requirements

title: Switch between project status groups
description: A delivery manager can move between project status groups and review different sets of projects without leaving the tracker.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects
Switch to the review status group
Switch to the completed status group
Verify the project list updates for the selected status group
Verify milestone and deadline information is still displayed

title: Review budget and deadline details for a project
description: A delivery manager can inspect project cards to confirm budget consumption and deadline dates are visible for active work.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects
Select an active project card
Verify budget consumption information is displayed
Verify deadline information is displayed

title: Review team role configuration
description: A manager can open the settings page and inspect the team role configuration used for agency access and responsibilities.

steps.description: Navigate to /settings
Review the team role settings
Verify team role configuration is displayed
Verify integration settings are displayed

title: Review landing page value proposition content
description: A visitor can browse the landing page sections that explain the product value, pricing, and social proof.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll through the page content
Verify feature information is visible
Verify pricing information is visible

title: Prevent saving settings with missing required fields
description: A user sees validation feedback when attempting to save settings after clearing required profile information.

steps.description: Navigate to /settings
Clear a required agency profile field
Save the updated preferences
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the settings are not saved

title: See required proposal fields before generating
description: A sales user gets clear validation feedback when trying to generate a proposal without the required inputs.

steps.description: Navigate to /proposals
Generate the proposal without entering the required fields
Verify proposal validation errors are visible
Verify no generated proposal preview is displayed

title: Handle an empty client search result
description: This verifies a user can enter a search term with no matches and see an empty state instead of results.

steps.description: Navigate to /clients
Search for a client name that does not match any record
Verify an empty state message is displayed

steps.description: Navigate to /jira
Verify an empty state message is displayed
Verify sprint metrics are not shown

title: Open project tracker with no active projects
description: A user can see a clear empty state when there are no projects available in the tracker.

steps.description: Navigate to /projects
Verify an empty state message is displayed
Verify project status filters are still available
